portInfo.description: Capri’s compact map hides substantial vertical separation. The commercial harbour, the Piazzetta and Anacapri offer different experiences, and trying to add a grotto boat trip to all three usually spends the day in queues. For a short call, one town and its nearby viewpoints are enough. The island’s Roman villas, monastic buildings and later literary connections give a culture-led visit substance beyond the shopping streets.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Marina Grande — commercial passenger harbour — Marina Grande,Capri
gettingThere.distanceToCity: The municipality distinguishes the western commercial harbour from the eastern leisure-marina basin. Follow the ship’s actual Marina Grande landing, not the private marina’s published yacht coordinate. The funicular’s ride is described as four minutes, but add ticket and boarding queues; budget 45 minutes from landing to Capri town on a busy call. Allow 45 minutes outward tender time and 90 minutes at the end for queue, boat and aboard margin. Anacapri needs a separate bus/taxi, with road and queue allowances. Dock 0 is the Motoscafisti operator’s base, not proof that every cruise tender uses that exact dock.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Piazzetta, Piazza Umberto I, Capri town: A clear named meeting point and a compact introduction to the hill town. Allow about 45 minutes (editorial estimate). Funicular queue is separate from the published ride time.

Giardini di Augusto, Giardini di Augusto, Capri town: Sea views and garden time without committing to a distant road excursion. Allow about 60 minutes (editorial estimate). Do not assume Via Krupp is open or use it as the required return route.

Certosa di San Giacomo, Certosa di San Giacomo, south of the Piazzetta, Capri: A monastic-history alternative near the central walking route. Allow about 60 minutes (editorial estimate). Interior access and current exhibitions need a date-specific check.

Villa Jovis, Villa Jovis archaeological site, Capri: Explore the Roman imperial layer on a dedicated walking outing. Allow about 90 minutes (editorial estimate). Allow generous uphill approach and return; not a quick add-on to Anacapri.

Villa San Michele, Villa San Michele, Anacapri: Axel Munthe’s villa and garden provide a focused Anacapri visit. Allow about 90 minutes (editorial estimate). Requires a separate road transfer; confirm museum access.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: On the way down, do not join a queue merely because it leads toward the harbour:confirm it gets you to the ship’s actual tender pickup. Finish sightseeing while there is still time for both the downhill transfer and the tender.
